name: opencode-v2-agent-orchestrator
description: A V2-only multi-agent orchestration plugin for OpenCode.

scripts.build: bun run build:plugin && bun run build:tui && bun run build:commands && bun run build:installer && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui.ts --outfile dist/tui.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:commands: bun build src/opencode-v2/commands/index.ts --outfile dist/commands.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:installer: bun build src/cli/install.ts --outfile dist/installer.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outfile dist/cli/index.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.dev:v2:dist: bun run build && bun run src/cli/index.ts dev-run --dist
